_comment: Live reference set for score calibration (plan 47, step 2). Each expected band comes from a manual review of the page, not from the tool's own output. `expected: null` = not reviewed yet; the test skips it. Live pages change: a drift means re-review the page or look at the tool, in that order.

sites.notes: Only medium/low findings, axe clean; own statement: partially compliant. B4 (#694): content outside landmarks is one finding per outermost block (like axe region) instead of one per text node; 92 -> 93. 2.0 (reference run 2026-11-01, 1.8.0 gave 93, now 98): best-practice advice such as `region` (2 landmark findings) is a review hint, no longer a confirmed WCAG failure (#779); one medium finding remains (label in name, 2.5.3). Band 85-100.
Only medium findings (text spacing). The 10 'links by colour' findings until 1.7.1 were standalone list links (li.home-list-item > a.home-list-link), false positives per #710.
Skip link with valid target, no reflow overflow at 320px, alt on all images, no high findings.
No high findings; links by colour only, skipped heading level, target size.

Contrast failures, orientation lock, two h1; own statement: partially conformant. B1 (#691): a missing aria-selected is now one REVIEW per tablist and only if no tab is selected (ARIA SHOULD), instead of six findings per slider tab; that adds about one point. B2 (#692): three label-in-name false positives at CSS-hidden text (button#navigation "schließen", two toggles outside the reading order) are gone, and the cookie dialog without aria-modal is a review (dialog/modal-unmarked); 61 -> 68. B4 (#694): landmark-unique is a review, dialog-no-focusable no longer fires on the cookie dialog whose buttons sit deeper than direct children, and content-outside counts per block; 72 -> 73. Re-review for 1.8.0 (83; 1.7.3 gives 72 on the same day): the 5 target-size findings were skip links at -99999 px (#705/#706), 4 presentation-semantic-children were false positives against WAI-ARIA 1.2 (dropped in #743), landmark-unique is a review and content-outside counts per block (B4), reduced-motion is 2.3.3 AAA and no longer runs at AA, and the 'orientation lock' was a media query for <=479 px in landscape, not a lock. Remaining: contrast undetermined (4), infinite animation hint, one high finding.

40x prohibited aria-label (star ratings), invalid ARIA values. B1 (#691): the search field's aria-controls="suggestions" with aria-expanded=false is no longer a finding (the list only exists once expanded; a11y-rules 0.13.2, like axe), which removes one High rule and adds about 10 points (28 -> 38). #779 (a11y-rules 0.26): the search field input#input-search-composing-search-input-field has only a placeholder, now forms/placeholder-as-label (REVIEW) instead of a critical forms/label-missing, and the svg without role img is svg/name-missing REVIEW; same live page measured 42 with 0.25 and 55 with 0.26, so the upper bound moves by 13.

Contrast failures (12), unnamed dialog, invalid role; own statement: only partially accessible. B1 (#691): the swiper lists (li[role=group]) are now lists/invalid-structure (Medium) instead of aria-roles (High), same two places, so the score sits about 7 points higher. Earlier desktop 71 came from a bot/load interstitial the tool audited (fixed on fix/berlin-instability); the real page scores 27 in both viewports. Re-review for 1.8.0 (49; 1.7.3 gives 42 on the same day), as announced on 2026-10-05: most of the 12-13 contrast failures were image credits and teaser titles over photos measured against an ancestor colour; with pixel sampling (#698) they pass over the photos, 1/3 real failures remain (e.g. a.title 3.98:1). Plus landmark-unique as a review (B4). 2.0 (reference run 2026-11-01, 1.8.0 gave 49, now 69): `link-in-text-block` (9, colour-only links with 3:1 contrast to the text) is a review hint to check hover/focus cues (G183), best-practice landmark advice is no longer a failure (#779), and 14 content-model reports are gone. Remaining: 3 contrast failures (high), 2 list-children, 1 empty heading. Band 40-75.

55 focusable elements hidden from AT, 49 contrast failures, empty links, no skip link, no statement. 2.0 (reference run 2026-11-01, 1.8.0 gave 23, now 38): 405 content-model findings were Angular `_ngcontent-*` attributes inside a `<ul>` (false positive, fixed), landmark advice is no longer a failure (#779). Still critical risk: 46 focusable elements under aria-hidden, 32 contrast failures, 4 ARIA failures. Band 15-50.
